data.name: App_Title
data.comment: Product name: never translate.

data.name: App_TitleWithVersion
data.comment: Product name: never translate. {0} = version.

data.name: Search_Placeholder
data.value: Search for a game, e.g. "witcher 3" or "hollow knight"

data.name: Filter_OfficialTooltip
data.value: Publisher-authorized stores such as Steam, GOG or Fanatical.

data.name: Filter_MarketplacesTooltip
data.value: Platforms where independent sellers list keys. Check seller ratings before buying.

data.name: Filter_OtherTooltip
data.value: Accounts, gift cards, random keys and other items that are not the game itself.

data.name: Filter_ConsolesTooltip
data.value: Show keys for Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo.

data.name: Filter_RegionTooltip
data.value: Hide keys that are locked to a region other than yours.

data.name: Stores_Header
data.comment: Sidebar heading, written in capitals where the script has them.

data.name: Welcome_Title
data.value: Find the best price for any game

data.name: Welcome_Text
data.value: Type a game title, or part of it, and Game Price Hunter checks official stores, key shops and marketplaces at once.

data.name: Welcome_Hint
data.value: Ctrl+F focuses the search box. Double-click a result or press Enter to open it in your browser.
data.comment: Use the key names printed on keyboards in this language (German: Strg, Eingabetaste).

data.name: Empty_NothingText
data.value: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or turn on more stores in the sidebar.

data.name: Empty_FilteredTitle
data.value: All offers are hidden by filters

data.name: Empty_FilteredText
data.value: {0} offers were found, but the current filters hide them.
data.comment: Plural: also _one (and _few, _many where the language has them). {0} = number of offers.

data.name: Empty_FilteredText_one
data.value: {0} offer was found, but the current filters hide it.

data.name: Summary_Ready
data.comment: Plural. {0} = number of stores.

data.name: Summary_Searching
data.comment: Plural by {1}, the number of stores searched. {0} = stores that answered.

data.name: Summary_Done
data.comment: After a search. {0} = Summary_Offers, {1} = Summary_FromStores, {2} = seconds; "s" is the unit symbol.

data.name: Summary_Offers
data.comment: Plural; part of Summary_Done.

data.name: Summary_FromStores
data.comment: Plural; part of Summary_Done.

data.name: Summary_Hidden
data.comment: Appended to Summary_Done after a middle dot. {0} = number of offers; write it so it needs no plural forms.

data.name: Region_SourceIp
data.value: Region detected from your internet connection. Click to change.

data.name: Region_SourceWindows
data.value: Region taken from Windows settings (could not detect it online). Click to change.

data.name: Region_SourceManual
data.value: Region chosen in Settings. Click to change.

data.name: Region_Compatible
data.value: Key region: {0}. Should activate in your region.
data.comment: {0} = region tag: Region_Global, Region_Asia or codes like EU, RU/CIS.

data.name: Region_Incompatible
data.value: Key region: {0}. Likely will NOT activate in your region.

data.name: Region_Unknown
data.value: Key region: {0}. Check the store page for activation restrictions.

data.name: Region_Global
data.comment: Region tag of keys that activate in every country.

data.name: Region_Asia
data.comment: Region tag of keys for Asian countries.

data.name: Rates_None
data.value: Exchange rates unavailable: prices are shown in store currencies

data.name: Rates_Info
data.comment: {0} = data source name, {1} = Time_JustNow, Time_HoursAgo or Time_DaysAgo.

data.name: Time_HoursAgo
data.comment: {0} = whole hours; "h" is the unit symbol.

data.name: Time_DaysAgo
data.comment: Plural. Exchange rates were updated {0} days ago.

data.name: Offer_BestPrice
data.comment: Badge, written in capitals where the script has them.

data.name: Offer_OriginalPriceTooltip
data.value: Price in the store's own currency

data.name: Provider_RetryTooltip
data.value: This store did not answer. Click to try again.

data.name: Provider_Found
data.comment: Plural by {0}. {1} = seconds.

data.name: Provider_Blocked
data.value: The store refused the request (bot protection or rate limit). Try again later.

data.name: Provider_TimedOut
data.value: The store did not answer in time.

data.name: Provider_Failed
data.comment: {0} = technical error message, usually in English.

data.name: Provider_NeedsApiKey
data.value: Add an {0} API key in Settings to use this source.
data.comment: {0} = store name (IsThereAnyDeal).

data.name: Note_RussianStore
data.value: Russian store: keys and gifts are usually for Russia and the CIS.

data.name: Note_CheapShark
data.value: Epic, Humble, GMG, IndieGala, WinGameStore and more. US prices in USD.
data.comment: Store names stay as they are.

data.name: Note_IsThereAnyDeal
data.value: Regional prices from 50+ authorized stores. Requires a free API key.

data.name: Settings_AutoValue
data.comment: {0} = the value picked automatically: a language, country or currency code.

data.name: Settings_RegionHint
data.value: Stores show regional prices and keys can be region-locked, so the country matters. Automatic uses the country of your internet connection.

data.name: Settings_TimeoutValue
data.comment: {0} = seconds; "s" is the unit symbol.

data.name: About_Version
data.comment: Product name: never translate. {0} = version.

data.name: About_Disclaimer
data.value: Prices come from the stores' public websites and may change at any time. Always check the final price, region and seller on the store page before buying.

data.name: Settings_CacheCleared
data.comment: Plural. {0} = number of images.

data.name: Update_Available
data.comment: {0} = version.

data.name: Update_Downloading
data.comment: {0} = percentage with the % sign, e.g. "45%".

data.name: Update_Installing
data.value: Installing the update. Game Price Hunter will restart in a moment.

data.name: Update_InstallFailed
data.value: The update couldn't be installed automatically. Try again, or download it from the download page.

data.name: Update_CheckFailed
data.value: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.

data.name: Edit_Cut
data.comment: Text box context menu.

data.name: Window_Minimize
data.comment: Title bar buttons, as Windows itself names them.
